outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: advance() now compares the executor stamp's scope list (parsed with _tree_stamp.parse_stamp) with _tree_stamp.declared_scope(task files) right after the filed return is read, before the gated mark is consulted. A difference prints the new scope-changed decision (options retry, close, block; close and block need --reason) whose why names filed-under/now counts and the added and dropped paths, with was/now lists kept in the pending state. retry re-starts the task through the existing retry answer (dispatch again under the new scope, one attempt spent); close records the accepted scope in a scopeAccepted mark (per start) and a did-line carrying the reason, then the close proceeds. The drive's own integration widen also records acceptance so it does not ask about its own widening. An unreadable stamp is no scope change (grade_stamp still reports it). Added the decide-scope-changed step and DECISIONS row. Tests: new _scope_change_cases stage (sc-block) in test_drive_phase.py with sc1, sc1b (decision persists), sc2 (close answer closes), sc3 (twin: no scope change closes as today), sc4 (retry dispatches, attempt +1).
